message: 守りたいものがある

name: Sally
message: 「N-No way, the great Sally-chan defeated... Uwaaah」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now that's a first-rate way to get beat.」

name: Sally
message: 「Thank youu\s04」

name: Sally
message: 「Wait, that wasn't a compliment!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan. The things you were trying to steal are important items meant to be sold at the upcoming Charity Bazaar.」

name: Sally
message: 「Shut uup. Hand 'em over, hand 'em over!! Give me yummy stuff!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh? Huh-uh? It's all just useless junk. I can't eat any of this.」

name: Ria
message: 「'Kupipo'」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai?」

name: Sally
message: 「There's no yummy food!! I've been tricked~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Yummy food...?」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Here, a manju. It's yummy\s04」

name: Sally
message: 「Wha-wha!? You think you can bribe me with this!? I'm not falling for that trick!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, do you happen to have a little more?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, here you go\s04」
He shares them with the Demon rolling around on the ground.

name: Tinun
message: 「Eee♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Waaah!! You traitooor!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sally-chan's share is gonna run out, you know?」

name: Sally
message: 「Then I'll eat it! *Nom*」

name: Ria
message: 「How is it? Yummy?」

name: Sally
message: 「Uwaaaan~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She started crying!?」

name: Sally
message: 「It's so yummy~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is it really that good……」

name: Sally
message: 「Thanks, big-boobed big sis!」

name: Ria
message: 「You're welcome. Though please drop that title, it's embarrassing\s01」

name: Sally
message: 「Aah~~. Beef bowls must be way, waaay~~ tastier than this~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Sally-chan, right? You seem obsessed with tasty food, so what exactly is your goal here?」

name: Sally
message: 「Heh-hehe~. We may not look it, but we're renowned gourmets even in the Demon World, going by the name----」

name: Sally
message: 「Delicious Food Squad♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Where did the idol part go, I wonder……」

name: Sally
message: 「I heard the Human World has tons of yummy food!! So we just had to go!!」

name: Ria
message: 「In that case, I think you should eat at a proper restaurant」

name: Sally
message: 「No way, no way! 'Cause they always yell at me right away. Even though I give them my treasured Demon World Mail-Order goods as thanks」

name: Synn
message: 「Demon World Mail-Order goods……?」

name: Sally
message: 「They're super items that put mere junk to shame!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And are you actually paying money for the food?」

name: Sally
message: 「Money? What's that? Is it tasty?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No wonder they yell at you!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Why though!! I'm doing a proper barter trade, aren't I!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Listen, Sally-chan. In the Human World, you have to use money like this」
Ria-senpai shows a 1-yen coin to Sally-chan.

name: Sally
message: 「Mine!!」

name: Sally
message: 「All right! With this, it's all-you-can-eat beef bowls!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally!」

name: Sally
message: 「Eek」

name: Synn
message: 「Taking money is stealing!! You must never do that!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Urk」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not just money. Stealing anything from someone is a crime, and scary guys will catch you and lock you up in a dark prison cell!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Whaaaat!? No way, I don't want thaaat」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It's okay, Synn. You don't have to get that mad……」

name: Synn
message: 「He who laughs at one yen will weep over one yen」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, I see…… You're teaching Sally because she doesn't understand how money works, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In short, that's what it is. Impressive as always, Senpai. You saw right through it」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though, some personal feelings have suddenly crept in too」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally. If you want money that badly, why don't you try doing a milk route or something?」

name: Sally
message: 「No way, forget that. That's way too much hassle」

name: Synn
message: 「He who does not work, neither shall he eat. With that attitude, you'll never get your hands on anything tasty」

name: Sally
message: 「What's with that high-and-mighty attitude!! I'm definitely gonna eat something delicious!! Toss!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah!! What have you done!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Leave this to the great me」
Paqy caught the tossed one-yen coin in his mouth.

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh…… Nice catch」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's Ria's one-yen coin, after all!!」

name: Synn
message: 「So, where is it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ngah-gulp」

name: Sally
message: 「You'll regret this, Student Council! I'm gonna pay you back for this humiliation someday!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, the manjuu were delicious, though!! Treat me again sometime!! Bye-byeee!!」

name: Synn
message: 「She's gone...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What a troublesome girl.」

name: Misa
message: 「The handcart is fine too. Nothing was taken.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There really are all kinds of Demons, aren't there~? That surprised me.」

name: Misa
message: 「I never even imagined there were humanoid Demons.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If they show up looking like that, there's no way to tell them apart~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You can totally tell just by looking at her, though.」
Look who's talking.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who knows, maybe there's one right under our noses.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hahaha...」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Ria-senpai...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Even a girl like her in the Human World... The effects of Re-Crea might be bigger than we thought.」

name: Synn
message: 「Demons like her didn't used to come here?」

name: Ria
message: 「Not as far as I know. The Demons that have appeared up until now didn't have much individuality, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I thought that's just what Demons were like.」

name: Ria
message: 「Apparently they look completely different in the Demon World. There are humanoid ones, animal-like ones, all sorts--but when they travel to another world, they end up taking that form.」

name: Ria
message: 「But I think that girl appeared just as she looks in the Demon World. Which means... Demons can already cross over into the Human World easily.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hurry... If that person doesn't get here soon...」

name: Synn
message: 「That person?」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh!? A-Aaah! It's nothing, it's nothing at all\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「When you say it like that, it makes me curious……」

name: Ria
message: 「Teehee. That's a se-cret\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Aaaah, look at the time already! Let's hurry up and clean up♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Big Boys is gonna start--!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder who that person Ria-senpai was talking about is」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's gotta be yours truly…… Hehehe」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaah, it's bothering me so much I can't sleep~~!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You can't go to sleep now, Demon Lord. Don't you still have to put together that proposal?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaah, that's right!! What time is it right now?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, let's see, roughly――」

name: Synn
message: 「Uwaaah!! It's that late already!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's still early」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't lump me in with you when all you ever do is take afternoon naps」

name: Paqy
message: 「Being Student Council President sure is tough……」
